sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Producer prices DE: bearings, gears, gearing and driving elements changed +0.8% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months.
Here is the background.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
As to the index change and volume change data you cited, that does not change our position.
We can accommodate your request for a 90-day payment term, which adjusts the unit price to €5.02.
Please provide the underlying data for your volume forecast, as the referenced document is not accessible to us.
Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown in due course.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We have noted your reference to past orders and the recent news article regarding our strategic focus.
As our operational priorities have shifted, we are unable to offer further concessions on this part.
We must therefore maintain our offer at €5.02 per unit for the requested 90-day payment term.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us again. We appreciate your updated proposal, but we are unable to accommodate your target price. Due to our shifted operational priorities, we cannot make any further concessions on this part. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Please consider this our final offer (letztes Angebot) at a price of €5.02 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. Please decide if you would like to proceed on these terms. 

Please note that this Angebot remains valid for 7 days. We truly value our business relationship and hope this arrangement works well for your ongoing requirements.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
